description: This PHP source file defines the class SugarWidgetFieldText, which extends SugarWidgetFieldVarchar. The class provides methods for filtering and displaying text fields within the SugarCRM / SuiteCRM framework, including methods for generating SQL filter conditions and rendering list views.

classes.name: SugarWidgetFieldText
classes.description: A CRM widget class for handling text fields, providing filtering and display functionalities in SugarCRM/SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the SugarWidgetFieldText object with a layout manager, calling the parent constructor.

methods.name: queryFilterEquals
methods.description: Generates a SQL condition for filtering records where the text field equals a specified value.

methods.name: queryFilterNot_Equals_Str
methods.description: Generates a SQL condition for filtering records where the text field does not equal a specified value, considering NULLs.

methods.name: queryFilterNot_Empty
methods.description: Generates a SQL condition for filtering records where the text field is not empty or NULL.

methods.name: queryFilterEmpty
methods.description: Generates a SQL condition for filtering records where the text field is empty or NULL.
